{{Quote|A Jedi has come to our rescue? I remember the Jedi, Guerno! I met one once, you know! Champions of the galaxy! Always said so! I knew someday they would come back.''"<br />[whispering] "''But, Captain Piard&mdash;aren't the Jedi the ''enemies'' of the Empire?''"<br />"''Well, ''these'' Jedi are our ''very'' welcomed ''friends'', Guerno!''"<br />[whispering] "''Yes, Captain!|Captain Piard and Guerno, regarding Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy 37" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Piard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. In [[137 ABY]], [[Piard's shipping vessel]] was boarded in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who demanded Piard's shipment of [[M-40 light repeating blaster|blasters]]. The captain and the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Guerno]] were rescued by the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cade Skywalker]], who used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince them that Black Sun pirates stole the cargo. Skywalker and his companions, [[Jariah Syn]] and [[Deliah Blue]] then took the shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] for themselves.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Well my Jedi friend, thank you for your timely rescue! You just name your reward. You'll find the Empire is good for it.''"<br />"''Got no doubt. I'm taking your cargo, Captain.|Captain Piard and Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy 37" />}}
[[File:Guernoandpiard.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Captain Piard speaks with Guerno.]]
Piard was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]] in [[137 ABY]], during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between [[Darth Krayt|Krayt's]] Empire and deposed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]]. Piard and the [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] [[Guerno]] were assigned to a [[Piard's shipping vessel|shipping vessel]] that was delivering cargo, which included [[M-40 light repeating blaster|Thunderbolt Mark 7 blasters]], via the [[Triellus Trade Route/Legends|Triellus Trade Route]].<ref name="Legacy 37" />

Piard's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] stopped at the [[5709-DC Shipping Lane]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]], and was boarded by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] affiliated with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. The pirates' captain, [[Dovrin]], threatened Piard and Guerno, demanding to know where the [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were. Piard objected when the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] pirate destroyed a [[Unidentified protocol droid (Piard)|protocol droid]]. Dovrin was interrupted by a noise nearby and sent several cronies to check on it. Shortly after, the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Cade Skywalker]] and his companions, [[Jariah Syn]] and [[Deliah Blue]], revealed themselves after boarding the vessel and rescued Piard and Guerno by [[Death/Legends|killing]] Dovrin and incapacitating the remaining pirates.<ref name="Legacy 37" />

Piard immediately thanked Skywalker for his assistance, believing from his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that he was a Jedi, and proclaiming that they were the champions of the galaxy. When Guerno quietly questioned Piard's words because Jedi were enemies of the Empire, Piard answered loudly that ''these'' Jedi were friends; Guerno then understood.<ref name="Legacy 37" />

When Skywalker demanded the shipment of Thunderbolt blasters, Piard began to object but was influenced by a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] from Skywalker, who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to persuade the Captain and Guerno to forget the encounter and believe that Black Sun took Piard's cargo. Skywalker and his companions then took it for themselves.<ref name="Legacy 37" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But&hellip;but&ndash;but&ndash;but&ndash;but&hellip;you're a Jedi! You're supposed to help!"''<br />"''Galaxy helps those who help themselves.|Piard and Cade Skywalker|<ref name="Legacy 37" />}}
Piard was light-skinned with [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and white [[Hair/Legends|hair]] with a mustache. As a captain in the Imperial Navy, Piard wore an Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer's]] [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]]. The captain objected when Dovrin destroyed the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] and was extremely thankful when Cade Skywalker rescued the Imperials from the Black Sun pirates. Although Piard initially objected to Skywalker's intentions with the shipment, the captain was susceptible to being influenced by a mind trick.<ref name="Legacy 37" />

==Behind the scenes==
Piard appeared in the [[Legacy (2006) 37|thirty-seventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]].<ref name="Legacy 37" />
